drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1606.05250. SQuAD v1.0 samples 536 of the top 10,000 English Wikipedia articles by internal PageRank, extracts 23,215 paragraphs after removing visual/table content and passages shorter than 500 characters, and splits by article 80/10/10. Qualified crowdworkers write up to five questions per paragraph in their own words and highlight answer spans. At least two additional answers are collected for every Dev/Test question. The final 107,785 QA pairs are evaluated after ignoring articles and punctuation: exact match accepts any ground truth, while macro token F1 takes the maximum over references for each question.
